content.comment_body: Is it possible to use a converter in [product_name] to convert RS485 to Profinet? If yes, how many bits can be transferred and in what format (M, AIW, AQW)?
Hello, This is not possible with [product_name]. You should post your question in the relevant forum, as this is the [product_name] forum.
I am attaching a file for further clarification.
[product_name] does not support Profinet, as [user_name] mentioned. It can only use Ethernet on versions like [article_no].
Alright, is it possible to convert Ethernet to RS485 using a converter within [product_name]?

Hi [user_name], Only Ethernet is supported on [product_name] modules such as [article_no]. There is no built-in protocol conversion in [product_name]. Older modules used a special PC cable, but that won't meet your needs either. Here is an overview explaining how that cable was used in previous generations: [url] [url] Hope this helps. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to achieve protocol conversion between Profinet and RS485, or Ethernet and RS485, with [product_name] modules. The responses clarify that [product_name] hardware does not support Profinet or protocol conversion between these interfaces, only Ethernet in newer versions like [article_no]. Lack of necessary hardware features and firmware leads to confusion and inability to perform the required protocol conversions in these devices.
